record.where: The working world (v3.20 — traffic writes the land, crews work it, every coin is seen)

clauses.text: traffic wears the delivery line and the charter line
Every completed delivery and every route-charter run is FEET: the walked line between the two towns wears in — trampled grass, then bare earth — whatever route the player took
the stages are permanent (grass needs human intervention to return), the tread spreads
green grass refuses plates
bare trail takes them
A bare trail can be IMPROVED, underfoot, with P
scrap plates (3 metal)

figure.note: a real P on the bare trail spends exactly 3 metal

clauses.text: each tier its own authored paint (riveted steel, bright-set stones, warm plank rows)
tiers only climb
then cobbles (3 ceramic)
then a wood way (3 timber)
laid ground is finished ground and never repaints as dirt
the way walks faster
and bare trail walks faster
its own speed
flat even over marsh (the boardwalk law)
presser walks-and-wears
From a terminal's Waylighters tab, the same pooled people go OUT
the PATH PRESSER walks the line until the ground agrees
All of them are visible in the world with their job on a label
mason cobbles and drains ceramic
the MASON lays cobble along it, a slab a stretch
forrester turns forest to meadow and banks timber
the FORRESTER walks to standing wood and fells it — the map itself changes, stump by stump, timber to the bank
hauler stocks the far shelf
the HAULER walks real freight onto the far end's worst shelf
and earns the caravan at Hauling 5
a back grown to Hauling 5 becomes the DONKEY CARAVAN

figure.note: a paid shift grows the hauler from Hauling 4 to 5 and the figure becomes the caravan (the card, the label, the donkey drawn)

clauses.text: thirty crates behind a patient grey donkey, drawn where it walks

figure.note: the caravan's next arrival puts exactly 30 onto the worst shelf

clauses.text: a provision a round

figure.note: the one paid shift takes exactly 1 provision from the bank

clauses.text: the three-hand cap and recall
three per town

figure.note: 3 / 3 out working, and a fourth is refused

clauses.text: the earned looter sweep
A companion trained to Hauling 2 sweeps ground cargo that enters the player's sight — reach grows with every level — stows it, and falls back in line

figure.note: at Hauling 1 the crate stays where it lies; at Hauling 2 the same back sweeps it

clauses.text: chips merge-count-animate per currency
Every currency lands as a SEEN, animated chip beside the trust readout
the Order's gold diamond for trust, a hearth-heart carrying the town's name for appreciation, the banded crate for materials
bursts merge into one chip that counts up, bumps, and fades
pave and fell ride the save and reload
and all of it survives the save
